name: Session Titles
description: Name sessions from their first prompt with a configurable model.
author: minih-git
safetyNotes: Reads bounded first-prompt text, session-owned pasted excerpts and compaction summaries for naming only. Sends them to the selected configured model through the host. Updates automatic titles with compare-and-set; manual renames always win. No full transcript, arbitrary file access, network credentials or tools are exposed. Model calls consume quota, with at most three first-title attempts per session and model configuration during one plugin activation.

en.name: Session Titles
en.description: Name sessions from their first prompt with a configurable model. Manual titles are never replaced.

zh-CN.name: 会话标题
zh-CN.description: 根据首轮请求自动生成会话标题，支持选择模型；手动命名始终优先。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 仅为命名读取有限的首轮请求、该会话粘贴文本片段和压缩摘要，并通过宿主发送给所选模型。不读取完整会话或任意文件，不接触模型凭据。仅更新自动标题，手动命名始终优先。模型调用消耗额度；每次插件启用期间，同一会话和模型配置最多尝试三次首轮命名。
